page.overview:
Who is Blair Family?

The Blair Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Mason Blair from To Be Beautiful, the second story of Fazbear Frights 1: Into the Pit.

Mr. Blair is Mason's father. He's a doctor, and Sarah assumes he and his family live in a mansion on the fancy side of town.

Mrs. Blair is Mason's mother. She's a successful real estate agent whose face is plastered on billboards. Sarah assumes she and her family live in a mansion on the fancy side of town.

Blair is an English-language name of Scottish Gaelic origin. The surname is derived from any of the numerous places in Scotland called Blair, derived from the Scottish Gaelic blàr, meaning "plain", "meadow" or "field".
